messages:
sara (docs): Hey team — I have 3 docs PRs that touch the migration guide + redirects and they need coordinated merges to avoid broken anchors in the preview. PRs: #4123 (move migration guide), #4127 (rename examples + redirects), #4130 (SDK snippet fixes). Doc-preview is failing on #4123 with an unresolved anchor. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4123--redwood-docs.netlify.app/migration.html#step-2

ben (eng): Can we cherry-pick the redirect mapping first (#4127) then merge the migration move (#4123)? Anchor break happens when the file moves before a redirect exists.

liam (platform): Confirmed — our link-checker flags the unresolved anchor when the path changes. Workaround is either a temporary redirect or make the link-checker warn-only for the PR. I can add a small redirect PR to keep previews green.

ci-bot: [ci] build failed on deploy-preview-4123 — 1 broken link: /migration.html#step-2 not found

sara (docs): Proposed plan: liam submits a temporary redirect PR (#4132) -> merge it, then merge #4123 (move), then #4127 (redirect cleanup), then #4130 (snippets). Requesting reviewers: @ben and @alex. Preferred merge window: today 18:00–19:00 PT. Any objections?

ben (eng): Fine with that order. I will prioritize review of #4123 once the redirect exists. To reproduce locally run `jekyll build` — error snippet I saw:```
Liquid Exception: Could not find anchor 'step-2' (migration.md)
```

alex (docs): I'll take #4130 (SDK snippets). Heads up: the new SDK renamed a helper; I'll include a backwards-compatible alias in examples so existing users don't break.

liam (platform): PR #4132 created (WIP) with one-line redirect map. I can flip the link-checker job to warn-only for 30 minutes around the merge window if we need to avoid transient failures.

sara (docs): Great — I'll add the `docs/merge-window` label and update PR descriptions with the merge order and rollback notes. After each merge we'll run the docs-e2e smoke script: `scripts/docs-smoke.sh --preview-url <deploy-preview>` to validate anchors.

ben (eng): :thumbsup: Also will monitor CDN/edge cache after merges; if old path persists I'll purge the cache for the affected redirect.

sara (docs): Thanks everyone. I'll ping here 10 minutes before 18:00 PT with the final checklist (redirect merged, CI green, reviewers ready). If someone needs to swap an approver please mention it now.
